design: Pool of virtual people (POPULATION, as the workday scenario), 10 independent workdays each (new seed per day; wake 07:00 after 7.5 h; check-ins 09:30, 12:00, 14:30, 17:00, each followed by a PVT-B 4 min later; webcam from 07:30). Outcome per person: MAE of predicting each observed (noisy, rounded) KSS rating from that day's earlier events (replay to t - 1 ms, clipped estimate).
note: Each day is replayed separately, so anchors and offsets do not carry across days; conservative for BlinkTwin (E).
tests: (i) non-inferiority of E vs B: one-sided 97.5% t upper bound of mean(E - B) < 0.10; (ii) superiority of E vs B and (iii) of E vs A: two-sided 95% t-interval entirely below 0
